units.source_text: 且说附近肥后国地方，有一个大夫监，拥有一门人口众多的家族，在当地颇有声望，是个权势鼎盛的武士。

en.t: Now, in the nearby province of Higo, there was a man called the Tayuu no Gen, the head of a large family with many dependents. He had considerable reputation in the area and was a warrior at the height of his power.

units.source_text: 这个乡下武士粗蠢无知，却也有几分爱好风流，意欲搜集美女，广置姬妾。

en.t: This country warrior was coarse, foolish, and ignorant, yet he had some taste for amorous refinement and wished to gather beautiful women and keep many wives and concubines.

units.source_text: 他闻知玉鬘貌美，对人言道：“无论何等残废，我都不嫌，定要把她弄到手。”

en.t: When he heard that Tamakazura was beautiful, he said to people, "No matter what defects she may have, I will not mind. I must have her for myself."

units.source_text: 便非常诚恳地派人前来求婚。

en.t: So he sent messengers to propose marriage with great earnestness.

units.source_text: 乳母十分厌恶，回答他说：“我们的外孙女决不要听这种话，她就要出家为尼了。”

en.t: The nurse was utterly disgusted and answered him, "Our granddaughter will never listen to such talk. She is about to become a nun."

units.source_text: 大夫监越发着急了，便屏除一切事务，亲自来到肥前，把乳母的三个儿子叫来，要他们做媒，对他们说：“你等若能遂我心愿，便是我的亲信，我一定大力提拔你们。”

en.t: The Tayuu no Gen grew still more impatient, set aside all other business, and came in person to Hizen. He summoned the nurse's three sons, asked them to act as go-betweens, and told them, "If you can fulfill my wish, you will be my trusted men, and I will certainly raise you up generously."

units.source_text: 两个兄弟被他收买了，回来对乳母说：“妈妈呀，这头亲事，我们起先认为不甚相称，委屈了这位小姐。

en.t: Two of the brothers were bought over by him and returned to say to their mother, "Mother, at first we thought this marriage was not very suitable and would wrong the young lady.

units.source_text: 然而这大夫监答应提拔我们，倒是一个有力的靠山。

en.t: But this Tayuu no Gen has promised to promote us, and he would in fact be a powerful patron.

units.source_text: 得罪了这个人，我们休想在这一带地方生活呢。

en.t: If we offend this man, we can forget about living anywhere in this region.

units.source_text: 小姐虽然出身高贵，然而她的父母不来认她，世人也不知道她是何等样人，那么高贵也是枉然。

en.t: Although the young lady is of noble birth, her parents have not come forward to acknowledge her, and the world does not know who she is. In that case, her nobility is useless.

units.source_text: 这大夫监如此诚恳地向她求婚，照她现在的境遇说来，实在是交运了。

en.t: For this Tayuu no Gen to seek her hand so earnestly is, considering her present circumstances, truly a stroke of good fortune.

units.source_text: 大概她原有这段宿世因缘，所以流寓到这边远地方来。

en.t: Perhaps she had this bond from a previous life, and that is why she drifted into exile in this remote place.

units.source_text: 现在即使逃避隐匿，有什么好处呢？

en.t: What good would it do now to run away and hide?

units.source_text: 况且那人很倔强，要是动起怒来，事情可不得了啊！”

en.t: Besides, that man is very stubborn. If he becomes angry, the matter could turn dreadful."

units.source_text: 两个儿子拿这话来威吓母亲。

en.t: The two sons used these words to frighten their mother.
When the nurse heard this, she became deeply worried.

units.source_text: 长兄丰后介对母亲说：“这件事情，无论怎么说，总不妥当，而且对人不起。

en.t: The eldest brother, Bungo no Suke, said to his mother, "No matter how one looks at this matter, it is improper, and we would be failing the young lady.

units.source_text: 父亲也曾立下遗嘱，我们必须从速设法，护送小姐进京。”

en.t: Father also left instructions in his will. We must quickly find a way to escort the young lady to the capital."
